Upper Text: [Burst Digivolve] [Rosemon]: Cost 0 by returning 1 [Yoshino Fujieda] to the hand.
[When Digivolving] You may suspend 2 Digimon or Tamers. Then, 2 of your opponent's Digimon or Tamers can't unsuspend until their turn ends.
[When Digivolving] [When Attacking] By returning 1 other suspended Digimon to the bottom of the deck, trash your opponent's top security card.
